notes.title: V2.0 New Team for Group 9: Irena
notes.content:
[b]V2.0 Update: New Team for Group 9:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064637/87ce6ef9152371dbd33509a5116f45229c8c53ab.png[/img]
Irena：【Magic】【Attack】
When attacking, spend 1% of current funds for 10x magical bonus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064637/fa003a061e729b9d20ce89ad5c2c91937038a1b9.png[/img]
Gold Shield：【Defense】
Spend 10% of current funds for a health cap 10 times the spent amount.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064637/894bc9cf02ecb049afe979182c5de2af5d1a2b76.png[/img]
Gold Bomb：【Physical】【Skill】
Spend 10% of current funds to deal 10x the spent amount in physical damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064637/7c49c8ae6f09bbbd6b3b4d3a8eaf235cab1ad056.png[/img]
Witch's Treasury：【Resources】
Reward Cost +4, Cost Limit +40.

Some team members have been balanced.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed the bug where starting a new game was not possible when returning to the main menu.
